advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a regression test that drift_refresh takes the cheap refresh path (not None / not full re-review) when an unrelated untracked file is present in the shared tracker.
evidence: orchestrator.py:658 `except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - unstable generation falls back to a full review` — an untracked file raising store-read-failure here is swallowed and returns None, forcing a full LLM re-review with no observable error

All existing drift_refresh tests run against a clean tree with the _CLEAN runner and never inject an untracked tracker file (tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_plan_review_gate.py:797,828,842,858,932,943)
The three new tests in tests/unit/test_plan_relation_snapshot.py:391,428,458 all call resign.resign_plan_review only — none exercise orchestrator.drift_refresh
ABSENCE: search_files for `untracked` in tests shows regression coverage only for the review-plan preflight, the sign_manifest fence, and resign — not the drift-refresh probe
advisory.finding: The orchestrator.py drift_refresh fix (ignore_untracked=True on generation.collect) has no regression test: no test injects an untracked shared-tracker file into the drift-refresh path, so a reintroduced strict check would silently pass CI. The change's own description states that without this fix 'a stray file silently forced a full LLM re-review' — a concrete observable regression (the cheap drift-refresh collapses to a full LLM review via the `except Exception: return None` branch) that is currently unguarded.
scenarios: A concurrent session leaves an untracked temp file in the shared .tickets-tracker while a drift-refresh probe runs; a future regression re-tightens the check and silently forces expensive full LLM re-reviews with no test failure

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a regression test exercising attest.py's fallback collect_plan_relation_snapshot path (initial_generation=None) with an untracked tracker file present, asserting signing still succeeds.
evidence: attest.py:135-141 `snapshot = (initial_generation.relation_snapshot if initial_generation is not None else ... or relation_snapshot_module.collect_plan_relation_snapshot(verdict["ticket_id"], repo_root=repo_root, ignore_untracked=True))` — the ignore_untracked path is the `initial_generation is None` fallback
attest.py:403-408 the second fallback in the drift-refresh re-sign builder, also only reached when initial_generation is None and relation_snapshot_value is falsy

ABSENCE: the new tests (tests/unit/test_plan_relation_snapshot.py:391,428,458) all route through resign with a collected initial_generation; none set initial_generation=None to exercise attest.py's fallback collect with an untracked tracker file
advisory.finding: The two attest.py fallback sites (collect_plan_relation_snapshot(..., ignore_untracked=True) at lines 140 and 407, reached only when initial_generation is None) have no regression test for untracked-file tolerance. The new resign tests only drive the initial_generation-collected path, so the fallback branches' untracked behavior is unverified and could regress unnoticed.
scenarios: An attestation-signing or drift-refresh re-sign path that reaches the fallback collect (initial_generation None) while an untracked tracker file exists — re-tightening the check would fail signing with no test catching it
